_comment: win_det TAPH sampler setup-margin sweep, issue #195 REPLAY of the issue #189 sweep on the
remedied sampler: win_det.XBUP is now dffr_fast (spec/decisions/0017; D-path and master-loop
gates scaled 2x, slave clocked through an inv_lv pair), netlist regenerated from
design/netlist/supervisor.spice (envelope netlist_identity below). Everything else is the
issue #189 sweep verbatim: same probe body, same stimulus (REF = the smoke bench's own Vck,
0.5 ns base delay, 30 ps edges, 1 ns period, vdd-scaled), same loads (REF drives XIREF + the
three sampler clock pins; TAPH drives XBUP.D; over carries the XIPO inv_lv load), same lead
lists per corner, same bup_end settled grading at 2.4 ns against 50 % of the corner's own rail.
ADDED for the #195 excursion check (issue Test Plan): bup_max / over_pk, the peak of
v(xwin.b_up) and v(over) over 1.3-2.4 ns -- whether the capture window leaves a transient
half-rail excursion on b_up that propagates to over (over_n inside supervisor).
t_bup_r errors exactly when b_up never crosses 50 % (the pass case at a healthy lead): that
error is the no-crossing observation, not a fault.
/home/ubuntu/share/pdk/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi is substituted at staging. Simulated, never measured.
